caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Files" application title
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 00:51"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Background
- Abstract geometric wallpaper with gradient of purple to red hues
- Central abstract design resembling flowing fabric or feathers

## Left Sidebar (Application Dock)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon (folder)
  - Ubuntu Software icon (orange square with white "A")
  - Help icon (blue circle with white question mark)
  - Trash icon (recycle bin)
  - Application grid icon (3x3 dots) at bottom

## File Manager Window
- **Window Title**: "Home"
- **Window Controls** (top-right):
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)
- **Navigation Bar** (top):
  - Back button (left arrow)
  - Forward button (right arrow)
  - Home button (house icon)
  - Address bar showing "Home"
  - More options button (three vertical dots)
  - Search button (magnifying glass)
  - View options button (three horizontal lines)
  - View mode dropdown (down arrow)
- **Left Sidebar Navigation**:
  - Recent
  - Starred
  - Home (selected)
  - Desktop
  - Documents
  - Downloads
  - Music
  - Pictures
  - Videos
  - Trash
  - Other Locations (plus icon)
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid of files and folders
  - **Top Row**:
    - Desktop (folder icon)
    - Documents (folder icon)
    - Downloads (folder icon)
    - Music (folder icon)
    - Pictures (folder icon)
    - Public (folder icon)
    - requirements.txt (text file icon)
  - **Second Row**:
    - server (folder icon)
    - snap (folder icon)
    - Templates (folder icon)
    - Videos (folder icon)
    - work_files (folder icon)
    - .bash_history (text file icon)
    - .bash_logout (text file icon)
  - **Third Row**:
    - .bashrc (text file icon)
    - .cache (folder icon)
    - .config (folder icon)
    - .gnupg (folder icon)
    - .ipython (folder icon)
    - .lessht (text file icon)
    - .local (folder icon)
  - **Fourth Row**:
    - .mozilla (folder icon)
    - .pki (folder icon)
    - .profile (text file icon)
    - .selected_editor (text file icon)
    - .ssh (folder icon)
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful (text file icon)
    - thunderbird (folder icon)
  - **Fifth Row**:
    - .var (folder icon)
    - .viminfo (text file icon)
    - .vscode (folder icon)

## Desktop Icon
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - Home folder icon (gray folder with house symbol)
  - Label: "Home"
